notes.title: June 24 Update: [Aquarium System Added]
notes.content:
New Aquarium & Equipment Placement

 During fishing, there's a chance to obtain fry, which can be raised in the aquarium
 Fish placed in the aquarium will occasionally generate random items or treasure chests
 Fish require oxygen, comfort, and cleanliness to produce rewards
 Install different devices to provide various resources

🛠️ Fixed several localization issues
💡 Improved memory usage
